groups.note: The column's kind, which fixes what a question may do with it: group, filter, add, count distinct, min/max, words and display (L1).

terms.meaning: filter: threshold · add: L2 · min max: yes · words: lexicon · shown: yes
group: yes (unnests `many`) · filter: member, pattern; threshold if ordinal · count distinct: yes · min max: if ordinal · words: values + lexicon · shown: yes
group: grains · filter: period · count distinct: yes · min max: yes · words: calendar words · shown: yes
group: via `names` · filter: via `names` · words: values; pattern for common / long / short · shown: display (L13)
group: through its concept · filter: exact; pattern with `match: pattern` · count distinct: yes · words: exact · shown: yes
filter: contains / starts with / ends with, only when the question asks for that pattern (query-grammar operators, built by the harness) · shown: yes

groups.note: The measure's quantity, which fixes how it folds across categories and time, how it averages and which statistics apply (L2); required on a measure.

terms.meaning: across categories: sum · across time: sum · average: fold ÷ count distinct instance · statistics: median, percentile (continuous, exact), stddev, variance, correlation, slope
across categories: sum · across time: `over_time` (end) per entity first · average: across members ÷ instances; over time: mean of period levels · statistics: yes

across categories: never · across time: never (`over_time: average` allowed) · average: `weighted_by`, or `plain_mean` (disclosed); else refused; a total = Σ(rate × `weighted_by`) · statistics: min/max, median, percentile; never inverted

across categories: read only · across time: read only · statistics: a row's grain = its non-empty key columns of kind dimension, date or identifier not tested by a choice, versions or window; read rows whose grain equals the question's axes; none or several per cell → refuse, listing the grains still possible
across categories: sum · across time: sum (`over_time` allowed) · average: as flow · statistics: disclosed as a plan figure; never combined with actuals

groups.note: Which display form this name is, shown in the order common > long > short > code > legal (L13); absent = common.

terms.meaning: The name people use. 'Contoso', 'Germany', 'Monday'.
The unabbreviated form of a coded name. 'United Kingdom' for GB.
The abbreviated form. 'Mon' for Monday, 'Jan' for January.
A machine identifier standing for the name. 'GB', 'DE', a numeric key.
The name in a trade or statutory register. 'Contoso, Ltd'.

groups.note: What an empty cell means, each value forming its own group with its own fold and match behaviour (L12); absent = unknown.
Says what a named non-member is told: world 'not a kind we know', data 'not in this data', open 'cannot say none, the list is open' (L4); absent = not established (gate warns).
Only proposed and ruled act: a ruled default applies, a proposed default is asked with it shown as suggested, the rest are inert (L3); trust follows the state (L14).

terms.meaning: acts: its default applies and is disclosed as proposed (L3, Y-6)
acts: a person's verbatim words decided it (L3)
inert: the data contradicted it (L3)
options (or a dataset's rows) and a default always written — an option, all or ask (R-2, B-1)
a pointer to the declaration or law that enforces it; the build fails if it contradicts (R-2)
prose: not enforced, counted debt owned by said[0].by, disclosed (R-2)
the word means the address (absent = binds)
the row taken, and disclosed, when one word binds several addresses
retrieves a rule, never binds

groups.note: The finding's disposition; an open finding that blocks an address makes a question reading it refuse (L14).

terms.meaning: The floor. Every column, nothing renamed, derived or dropped — computable from the catalog, so no judgement was exercised and none is claimed. Generated by tools/mac_passthrough.py, which never touches a .sql that already exists.

The platform's own suggestion, made from measurements it already holds — row counts, distincts, measured references, duplicate relations, orphans. It is a RECOMMENDATION and not a ruling: `because` names the finding that motivated it, and until a person answers that finding the proposal stands as the reason this transform has the shape it has.
A person decided — an SME or a data scientist — and `because` names what they answered. Nothing regenerates a ruled transform.

groups.note: Every finding the MAC compiler can report — the CLOSED taxonomy, whether or not it fired here.

terms.meaning: undefined-artifact — present in the bundle, carries no MAC definition, not declared out of scope
invalid-artifact — has a MAC definition and does not satisfy it
undeclared-extension — an x- key with no profile entry — CONFORMANCE.md §2: undeclared debt, not license
fact-restated — one fact stated in more than one home; nothing keeps the copies in step
fact-contradicted — statements of one fact disagree — something downstream is reading the wrong one
capability-unadopted — MAC offers a mechanism for this and the bundle does not use it
claim-unearned — a conformance level or confidence asserted with no evidence behind it
change-unprotocolled — an authored or tuned object with no entry in the change record
guard-dead — a rule or guard testing a value that cannot occur — it can never fire
reference-unresolved — a reference that resolves to nothing
coverage-missing — a required completeness the bundle does not reach

extension-duplicates-core — an `x-` extension key. Prohibited outright, because it sits BY CONSTRUCTION outside every gate MAC has, so nothing can check what it holds. Measured the day x-grain was retired, TWO of four declared cell keys were false — the main fact view claimed 0 multi-row against millions, and a second fact view claimed 0 against nearly all of its cells. The two that HELD are the two that a view enforces: a view that withholds ambiguous cells, and a current-snapshot view whose collapse makes the key true by construction (its declared cell count reproduced to within a hundred-odd cells). That is the shape of the defect: the declaration is false exactly where nothing makes it true, and a field no gate can reach costs nothing to be wrong in. Three mechanical predicates identify the duplicate case — same subject, same value shape, same closed domain with non-empty overlap. Where there is NO core equivalent the finding is a MAC gap, not a shortcut: say what the wall is and change MAC, rather than declaring beside it. Enforced by tools/check_extension_keys.py, which exits non-zero, because a check that does not block is not enforcement.

groups.note: The fixed laws behaviour follows from the declared facts (GRAMMAR_v3 §4).

terms.meaning: Build — Closed grammar, fixed layout, identity keys equal file names. Every pointer kind resolves, reported with its denominator. Every served column has `is:`; a column is read when a concept serves it, a key, edge, rule, check, lexicon row or dataset key (`valid`, `known`, `membership`, `names`, `parent`, `within`, `weighted_by`, `unit_from`, `unit_to`, `once_per`, `observed_at`) names it, or it is `hidden` with a reason (reported as debt); unread datasets are reported, internal ones as internal. Key unique and non-null (a key column with `empty_means: not_applicable` may be empty); `valid` windows of one instance never overlap. Every check holds unless a finding waives it. Every choice has a default (`default` or `default_column`; exactly one row carries the default column); every rule exactly one form; `implemented_by` holds (not checked for falsified rules). A concept `where` literal exists in the column's values; `where` only on a shared table or with a rule saying the excluded rows are not this concept; two concepts may serve the same measure column only with disjoint `where`s or different `counts`; an `about` column is served by its parent concept. `names` 1:1 (inside `within` when set), `parent` many:1 (unless `parents_overlap`), `once_per` functional, `copy_of` equal; value sets reconciled with every linked column; `complete` only on dimensions, with a transform producing it or a watchdog result; value-set keys and linked columns are dimensions. Edges have one of `columns` / `range`. Ids in `retires` / `formerly` never reappear (readers resolve them to `now_at`). `data_signoff` gates ontology edits; nothing reads an `out_of_scope` path; a stale one fails; accounts cite every served column and parented rule. Several `binds` rows for one word without a `default` are reported (they ASK at run time).

Kind — By a concept: its instance, shown by its common name. `withheld`: find/filter only. A `many` group overlaps (disclosed; the total is never the sum of the groups). The rows behind a figure show the counted concept's `serves`.

Fold — Never added across a tested column or a `not_added_over` column. `unit_from` (per-row unit) → pin or group it. `within_pinned` → inside one member. `once_per` → sum over distinct keys. A fan-out: de-duplicated by the concept's key (disclosed), else refused. Asking below the dataset's key grain is refused unless the edge has `allocate_by`. Ratio legs fold at their own grain (legs on two datasets join through edges to the shared concepts, at one reference date); `scope`: filtered = the question's filters, breakdown = drop the shared-out axes, all = drop all but period and defaults; a zero denominator gives no value (disclosed). A folded figure carries a kind (sum/count → flow, average/ratio → rate, min/max → precomputed) for an outer fold. Sample vs population comes from the question; a statistic the dialect lacks is refused; approximate percentiles are disclosed.

Choice — Only `proposed` and `ruled` rules act, and both apply their default; a default from a `proposed` rule is disclosed as proposed, and the trust line names it (L14; decided 2026-11-16, Y-6). Superseded, retired and falsified rules are inert. A NAMED option is taken whenever its words are used, wherever its concept sits; two or more options named → side by side, never combined; grouping by the choice's word ("by channel") → every option side by side; a word on several options (or on an option and its `of:` sub-option) → ASK among them, showing each figure (D-closed); `of:` implies the parent option; an option the concept lacks → refuse; `for:` beats the default. A DEFAULT applies when: the choice's own words are used (a choice the lexicon points at triggers only on them); rows / keep / `from:` → the concept is the subject; route → the question reaches the target from a subject with several routes, in either direction (the target as subject too) — a route choice lists the only routes, an unlisted route is refused, and it beats "one hop wins"; column / ratio / compute → its own words; window → a figure is aggregated with no period stated; a date-column choice → a period is stated; no figure named → the measure choice whose `about` includes the fact the subject reaches. Filtering, aggregating or naming an equivalent column (a name or copy) of a tested column displaces that default, said; a named `all_rows` option, or counting / listing by the dataset key, releases every rows default of the concept and the placeholder exclusion. Defaults: option → apply + disclose (other options' figures when cheap); `all` → no filter; `ask` → ask with every option's figure; `default_column` → the row marked true.

Completeness — A named value that is not a member → refuse (never zero), saying how many members were compared and listing them when ≤ 20: `world` "not a kind we know", `data` "not in this data", `open` "cannot say none, the list is open", outside project `scope` "known but not covered" (unqualified totals exclude out-of-scope rows, disclosed; a resolved member's row is intersected with scope). Zero only for a real member with no rows. Placeholder members: excluded from counts, rankings and "how many", kept in breakdowns, shown marked in plain lists, askable, share disclosed. A `complete` set is derived (made by a transform) or watched (daily reconciliation outside the build; a new value raises a finding).

Time — "Latest / last N" anchor on the newest value of the date column the period binds to, over the dataset's default rows (or `anchor_over`). "This / now / today" use the reference date; a date stated in the question replaces it; the date used is disclosed. Last <grain> = last complete at the profiled grain; this <grain> = partial, disclosed; YTD ends at the anchor. A period binds to the fact's date before the subject's own dates; columns named in `valid` / `known` / `membership` and other dates only when their words are used; a dateless concept through the edge whose word is used, else the route choice, else ASK; several candidate dates and no date choice → ASK. Period words bind to the project `calendar` dataset's columns named by its lexicon rows, else the built-in calendar with `fiscal_year_starts`, `fiscal_periods`, `week_starts` (a bare "Q1" with fiscal settings → fiscal, disclosed). Timestamps are in the project `time_zone`; day boundaries are taken there. Never finer than the profiled grain. Half-open periods. `uses_as_of` columns (ages) disclose the reference date.

Versions — `valid` declares versions of one instance (several rows per instance; lifecycle dates of distinct instances are plain dates): a concept whose instance is coarser than the key counts each instance once at the reference date (or the edge's `at` date; an edge on a version's own key reads that version); counting by the key reads every row; "active in March" = overlap. `known`: what was known at the reference date; never fold across. `membership`: overlap only. No versions: historic facts show today's attributes, disclosed; a `no_history` attribute is refused as a fold input over history. `all_rows` reads every version.

Edges — The only joins, walked in both directions (cardinality per direction), compared from the subject; one hop wins unless a route choice lists the routes; identical-result routes need no choice; never across a second fact unless an edge says so; concepts on one dataset share its rows, and an edge serves every concept on its from- and to-datasets. An edge's `rows` limits the rows it joins; the target concept's `where` applies before the to-one test (a constant on the target, e.g. from_currency, sits in the rate concept's `where`). Unmatched rows follow measured participation (kept under a not-found member, disclosed); edge checks gate it. A to-many hop only filtering is a semi-join. An edge from a `many` column joins each element. `range` joins the row whose [start, end) holds the value. `allocate_by` weights a bridge. Edges into a value set that only supply names resolve at planning. To-one when `theirs` is the target key or a `unique` check.

Words — The harness offers every candidate (lexicon `binds` rows, name columns, eligible stored values, and the `means` sentences); the model chooses; the harness verifies a declared address; several plausible → the lexicon `default` row if one, else ASK. Ranking among candidates: option and choice words > column words (on the subject's own dataset first) > name and member words > stored values; a definition phrase (column lineage) outranks a column word; inside one choice, L3. A linked column takes words only from its value set. Ladder: exact → near miss (the framework normalisation: accent strip, case-fold, punctuation and whitespace collapse — one implementation) → ASK; no home → refuse naming what was searched (data gap when a lexicon row points at a finding). No word is ever resolved by searching the warehouse (RULED-2026-10-16, RULED-2026-10-22, kept 2026-11-16); a name with no value set and no lexicon row refuses, naming what was searched. Pattern filters a question itself asks for (contains / starts with / ends with) are query-grammar operators on columns marked `match: pattern`, never a word lookup. Several members → `shared_words`. A scoped value (lexicon `scope`, or a `within` column): one in-scope carrier → take it (disclosed); several → ASK among carriers, offering `within_else`; with `within_pinned`, a total, comparison or ranking across scope members → refuse, offering `within_else`. Tier list or index by profiled size, disclosed; `match` overrides.

Evidence — An absent row is no evidence for a measure value, never a zero, unless `missing_rows: zero` and the axes are complete (`world` or `data`), per period within measured coverage; then a complete axis emits every member. Presence = a non-zero fold. Existence tests read absence within coverage, disclosed. A refusal names the confusable options.

Units — One unit per measure; unit algebra, scaled and compound units, precision per (unit, statistic) are framework vocabulary. A currency named after "in" names the unit only when a converted dataset exists (its measures carry that unit, made by a transform), else refuse.

Hierarchy — `parent`: grouping discloses the level; the coarser member wins a shared word; a `parent` pointing at the dataset's own key column = recursive tree (a node means its subtree); a parent elsewhere = plain roll-up; `parents_overlap` → counted in every parent, disclosed. Buckets: only-inside → the bucket's figure, never split; own and inside → its own, the bucket's beside it; rolled-up members disclosed when the group was named. No `parent` = independent (the profile flags undeclared dependencies). `within` travels.

Empty — Each `empty_means` value forms its own group, shown as its meaning. `unknown`: excluded from counts and complements say so; `zero`: counts as 0 in folds; `not_applicable`: never matched, excluded from averages; `not_yet`: left out of averages; `ambiguous`: never matched by a member word. is_not / not_in keep empty rows unless `unknown`. Disclosed when it changed the answer.

Types & display — Type families and what each allows are framework vocabulary; the profiler records each column's family; a compared value must match. Display: common > long > short > code > legal, one common per `names` per language (a withheld one falls to the next); answer language = first project language. Default order when the question states none: dates ascending, measures descending, names ascending; never a limit; ties by remaining output columns, then the concept's key; an ordinal dimension by its rank.

Disclosure — Carried as structure (addresses + values; the prose is generated): defaults taken (with other options' figures when cheap), rules applied with `says` and state, laws that changed the answer (fold, completeness, versions, level, empty, placeholder exclusion, a narrowing `where`, a void qualifier — one selecting the same rows as without it), the counted identity, structural facts relied on with their measurement, dates covered and the date used, transform repairs behind each dataset read, findings on what was read (an open finding that `blocks` an address → refuse with the finding: NEEDS_SME), trust (generated < authored < rule proposed < rule ruled: the weakest touched), and for every refusal the remedy.

Answerability — A fixed container verdict — answerable / not answerable / not established — from: layout and gates pass, profiles present and newer than the last data or transform change, interpreter and model catalog present, connector pinned to a major, `data_signoff` present; it never depends on whether the source is up. Reachability is a separate live status (probed within `probe_ttl_s`). The runtime publishes the laws it implements and the key→reader table; a bundle using a key the runtime does not implement fails.

Record — Every record key names its reader: rule `said / asked_in / supersedes / retires / formerly / evidence / examples` and the `.md` accounts → gates, console and the model's concept/rule view; finding keys → L14 and console; project `interpreter / model_catalog / refuse_below / time_zone / languages` → runtime; `label` → display.
